mintAuthority.summary: USDM is centrally issued on Cardano by Moneta and NBX against stated segregated reserves; the mint is enforced on-chain by a PlutusV2 policy gated on a one-shot state-thread token whose counter datum reconciles cumulative supply, but the validator that guards the controlling token has not been decompiled, so the terminal signer set remains unattributed.

controls.label: Moneta / NBX issuance backend
controls.evidence: Moneta (USA) and NBX (EEA) operate the centralized 1:1 mint/redeem for USDM against segregated reserves; a Charli3 oracle attests reserve backing on-chain before each mint, but issuance remains issuer-controlled with no permissionless route.

controls.label: USDM Cardano minting policy
controls.capDescription: Minting is validated by an on-chain PlutusV2 policy script parameterized by a one-shot state-thread token, so it is not an unconditional key-signed mint; the numeric bound enforced inside the compiled validator was not decompiled and no ceiling is claimed.

controls.evidence: Correction to the 2026-07-20 first-pass finding: the earlier review queried Koios with the 72-character Cardano asset unit as if it were a script hash, which cannot match. Querying the 56-character policy id c48cbb3d5e57ed56e276bc45f99ab39abe94e6cd7ac39fb402da47ad on 2026-07-20 returns a PlutusV2 script of 392 bytes created in tx c6b0831fa16e101ae18de65c2a0c8825cebffe17ccfe38385e711c900f62d261, and policy_asset_info returns the CIP-68 pair 000643b05553444d (reference NFT, supply 1) and 0014df105553444d (fungible USDM, supply 9,552,424,930,000 at 6 decimals). The compiled policy carries the appended parameter constr0(bytes e319d8e6629ff7991c8ae4f8aec2e0f10463ebdf29b57d26d34914f6, "USDM_COUNT"), so minting is gated on a one-shot state-thread token rather than on a bare signing key. The mint authority is therefore a script, not an EOA or multisig; which party may satisfy that script is recorded on the separate control-token validator entry.

controls.label: USDM_COUNT state-thread validator
controls.capDescription: Holds the single USDM_COUNT token whose inline datum carries the cumulative minted supply; the validator is parameterized by a USDM_CONTROL token and a USDM_ORACLE token, but its spending conditions were not decompiled.
controls.evidence: Read 2026-07-20. The USDM_COUNT one-shot token (policy e319d8e6629ff7991c8ae4f8aec2e0f10463ebdf29b57d26d34914f6, supply 1) sits at script address addr1wy6ahmv4nku72dxrymvxd9dqqzm3l7ympczr0unnqn344aq9tmcsd, which bech32-decodes to header 0x71 and script hash 35dbed959db9e534c326d86695a000b71ff89b0e0437f27304e35af4 (PlutusV2, 5,148 bytes). Its inline datum d879821b000008b018e50ad0d87980 decodes to constr0(int 9552424930000, constr0()), exactly matching the on-chain USDM fungible supply, the counter is reconciled on-chain per mint. The validator's appended parameters name the USDM_CONTROL token under the same one-shot policy and a USDM_ORACLE token under policy 59607e564f796b426e13e2add2b1ceca5274509fabef6a10d2367fe9, corroborating that the Charli3 reserve feed is enforced as a mint precondition on-chain rather than only by issuer policy. The single USDM_CONTROL token is itself locked at script address addr1w94newr03thfkht4fwn6luava2vx99lgx02j4u9spmlr03c266alt (script hash 6b3cb86f8aee9b5d754ba7aff3acea986297e833d52af0b00efe37c7, PlutusV2, 3,649 bytes) with no inline datum, so no signer set, threshold, or recovery path is attributable without decompiling that validator.

review.evidence: Historical control observations retain their original review start of 2026-08-15. The July 20 first pass used an invalid Cardano asset-unit query as a policy hash; the corrected 56-character policy query returned the PlutusV2 policy c48cbb3d5e57ed56e276bc45f99ab39abe94e6cd7ac39fb402da47ad. July 28 Koios script_info at block 13733605 identified its 392-byte script and creation transaction c6b0831fa16e101ae18de65c2a0c8825cebffe17ccfe38385e711c900f62d261. Policy identity is immutable because changing the mint-policy bytes changes the native asset ID; USDM_COUNT/USDM_CONTROL spending conditions remain separate from replacing that policy. The earlier datum observations reconciled the supply counter to native-token supply, not financial reserves to all holder liabilities. The Sundae Labs audit concerns the original oracle-bounded design, while the active count-validator hash differed and its ceiling and terminal authority remained undecompiled. Those historical pins, unknown economic cap and evidence of an oracle are retained. ORCHESTRATOR-AUTHORIZED adverse-pin correction — owner review required: favorable continuous reconciliation and attestation-only supervision credit are withdrawn on 2026-10-20 because the cited pre-mint reserve-feed description does not establish whole-token supply-to-backing reconciliation by a named independent party. The current NBX whitepaper notified 2026-09-24 defines legally distinct Moneta and NBX reserve books with no pooled or cross-backed reserve, excludes NBX own-account tokens from its backing denominator, and describes a reserve-verification oracle for the relevant issuer's post-mint circulation; it does not name the current provider. Moneta's February 19 reserve-architecture article describes daily Moneta-signed reserve data relayed by an oracle, while its current transparency page supplies no matched combined-book liability partition. No recurring whole-token reserve-to-liability accounting identity or named whole-liability attestation regime is established. Reconciliation, supervision and the authored aggregate posture are therefore unknown; no absence of all issuer accounting, actual reserve shortfall, arbitrary mint exploit or complete prudential coverage is asserted. The original control and review dates are not renewed by this correction.
